status: proposal (J): every number below that DECISIONS.md does not fix is the team's judgement and can move before the settings card is signed (Sun 1 Nov 2026). Nothing here is signed by an agent.
about: The phone file is cut from the ProRes 422 HQ master (never from the venue file, never from RGB frames) and is the same 16:9 picture: no reframing, no crop, no vertical cut (W-63). It differs from the venue file only in its caption burn-in and its encode. The 'chains' and 'profiles' objects have the shape of pipeline/lib/chains.json and pipeline/settings.json, so `colour_patch.py --chain-file` and `spec_check.py --profiles-file` read this file as it is. The other top-level objects (caption, encode, check) are read by encode_phone.py and phone_check.py only.

phone_1080.used_for: PH1, the phone file (W-63): 1920x1080 at 24 fps, H.264 High 4.1, CRF 20 with an 8 Mbps cap, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo 192 kbps, faststart, metadata stripped; -16 LUFS integrated and -1 dBTP are set by the audio stage and measured on the final file
phone_1080.notes: Level 4.1 and the 8 Mbps cap are W-63 and the mobile-delivery T-M1 template. -g 48 is two seconds at 24 fps (seeking on a phone). CRF 20 keeps 73% of flat-patch grain in the research fixtures (J). The caption burn-in (the ass filter) goes BEFORE this vf in encode_phone.py, so the captions are drawn on the 1080 frame and then scaled, matrixed and tagged with the picture.

phone_720_share.used_for: PH2, the small copy for slow links and low-storage phones (W-63): 1280x720 at 24 fps, H.264 High 3.1, CRF 22 with a 3.5 Mbps cap, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo 160 kbps, faststart, metadata stripped
phone_720_share.notes: The plan says about 3.5 Mbps; W-63 says a 4 Mbps cap. 3.5 is inside both. colour_patch.py measures a chain at its own output size, so it tests this 1280x720 chain directly (worst 1/255 on 6.1.1, build/evidence/wp08); approved stays false until a maker's-PC build has been tested (W-16).

phone_1080.description: phone file PH1: 1080p24 H.264 High 4.1, yuv420p, BT.709, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo, faststart, -16 LUFS / -1 dBTP

phone_720_share.description: phone small copy PH2: 720p24 H.264 High 3.1, yuv420p, BT.709, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo, faststart, -16 LUFS / -1 dBTP

caption.status: (J) the size is picked from the measured candidates in build/evidence/wp08/caption_candidates.json, not guessed; see the rule in the 'chosen_by' field; max_chars_per_line 32 is the build plan's figure (W-18 says 36)

burn_in.why: ffmpeg before n9.0 draws the `subtitles` filter in simple shaping and breaks Indic conjuncts and vowel signs without any warning (W-75; measured again here, build/evidence/wp08/shaping_paths.json). The `ass` filter on an ASS file made from the SRT shaped correctly on 6.1.1 in the same test. The same path is used for every script and every build.

ass.note: 384x288 is the canvas ffmpeg itself gives an SRT, so FontSize and MarginV here mean what FontSize and MarginV mean in the settings card (W-16, W-18): one unit is 3.75 px on a 1080p frame.

phone.description: PH1 / PH2 caption: two lines, at most 32 characters a line, white with a black outline (2 units, 7.5 px at 1080p), box ending at or above 88% of picture height so a 20:9 phone filling the screen (about 10% cropped top and bottom) still shows the whole bottom line
phone.chosen_by: the smallest candidate FontSize whose Latin x-height in landscape reaches the target (21 arcmin) at the 35 cm design distance and the floor (18 arcmin) at the 40 cm margin distance, whose x-height and Devanagari base-letter band are at least 3.2% of picture height, and whose two-line block ends at or above the fill_20x9 limit inside the 90% box (build/evidence/wp08/caption_candidates.json; re-derived by `phone_check.py --candidates`). The rule picks 28, which is also the FontSize of W-18. Indic faces are sized per script later (W-18 sizes Gujarati by the height of KA): font_size_by_script stays empty until a reader of that script has looked.

venue_fs23.description: REFERENCE ONLY, NOT A PHONE DELIVERABLE: the venue caption of the settings card (W-16, W-18): FontSize=23, MarginV 20. It exists so the phone check can write the FontSize-23 finding and so the 'clip burned with the venue margin' test has something to burn.
venue_fs23.chosen_by: the settings card (pipeline/settings.json captions.font_size); MarginV 20 is the card's 'MarginV 20 or more'

loudness.mode: two-pass loudnorm, second pass linear, then AAC; the final audio is measured and the true-peak target is lowered and the pass repeated if the AAC file reads above -1.0 dBTP (the AAC encode can add 0.3 dB or more)

encode.neutral_names: output file names are given by the caller; the tool never writes a title, comment or encoder-specific tag beyond what -fflags +bitexact leaves, and prints only base names
